zone.label: Autoflow zone
zone.hint: Applies a condition to creatures inside the region and removes it on exit or expiry.

condition.label: Condition slug
condition.hint: pf2e condition applied while inside (e.g. concealed).

expiresAt.label: Expires at (world time, s)
expiresAt.hint: 0 = never. The region is deleted when world time reaches this value.

persist.label: Restore if deleted early
persist.hint: Recreate once if the region is deleted within 2 minutes of creation (e.g. by pf2e-toolbelt Template Helper).

challenge.title: {save} save, DC {dc}
challenge.noTargets: No targets: target tokens or place the template, then roll.
